system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: Raj.iyer had a successful interactive logon to WS-RIYER-01 at 13:21 UTC, followed by the expected userinit.exe and explorer.exe startup chain.
At 13:23 UTC, DC-LV-01 recorded Kerberos ticket activity for raj.iyer from 10.20.10.23; WS-RIYER-01 then recorded a successful network logon for raj.iyer identifying WS-KORTEGA-01 as the workstation.

Chrome on WS-RIYER-01 accessed drive.google.com. Google Drive is not listed among the organization's approved services, but these records show page access and modest connection traffic, not an upload or data transfer.
The GlobalProtect PanGPA.exe client was launched under raj.iyer's session and loaded a validly signed Palo Alto library. The records do not show that it established a VPN connection.
At 14:10 UTC, OneDrive.exe ran under raj.iyer's session and the proxy recorded access to OneDrive and related Microsoft endpoints, consistent with an approved service.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied collection-status information says DC-LV-01 and FILE-LV-01 winsec and Sysmon data were not collected from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC because of a Windows Event Forwarding outage. This overlaps the alert time and prevents review of domain-controller authentication events and relevant server activity during that period.

The supplied records do not include an event establishing the reported repeated failed logons around 13:40 UTC; the missing domain-controller telemetry makes that report difficult to verify from this evidence.
